parent_objective: implement no-checkpoint proposal-source preflight before proposal repair
blocked_by: M1649 requires proposal-source preflight before any proposal repair or checkpoint artifact

public_gates: M1650 must evaluate proposal-source availability without repair
M1650 must include M1362 base anchor smaller controls and larger proposal alphas
M1650 must compute exact contour-aware residual metrics for compatible candidates
M1650 must select at least one repair candidate as metadata if available
M1650 must write no checkpoint artifacts and run no projection
M1650 must route to result audit
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat diagnostics as positive targets
do not treat donor_plus_hidden_action as a loss target

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements no-checkpoint proposal-source preflight before any repair run
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: infrastructure preflight only; no PPO, training, projection, proposal repair, checkpoint artifact, closed-loop gate, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if no compatible proposal candidates exist
stop if source preflight writes checkpoint artifacts
stop if preflight runs projection or repair
stop if actor input contract changes
stop after implementation for mandatory result audit
fallback_plan: route to result audit whether preflight passes or fails
if no compatible proposal exists, design branch-local PPO proposal generation later
if candidates exist but exact residuals are null, audit and pivot to proposal construction or objective refresh
if preflight passes, design selected-proposal no-checkpoint repair
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1649 admits one no-checkpoint source preflight implementation

admission_evidence: M1649 design selects no-checkpoint proposal-source preflight before repair
M1630 contour-aware materialized target tensors exist
allowed_updates: preflight module or extension and focused tests
M1650 docs status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: selected repair candidates are metadata only
no projection or checkpoint artifact is produced

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1650 evaluates fixed proposal sources against fixed tensors and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: evaluates exact correct/wrong hidden residual metrics only; no new closed-loop history intervention
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1362 and M1630 public artifacts only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If no compatible proposal candidates or measurable residuals exist, route to audit before designing PPO generation or repair.
allowed_claims: no training, no PPO, no projection, no checkpoint artifact, no private-holdout, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1362 same-line interpolation candidates provide branch-compatible proposal sources for a later no-checkpoint damped projection repair probe.
success_criteria: training_started_count ppo_used_count promoted_count private_holdout_used_count actor_input_contract_changed_count level3_self_id_claim_count are 0
failure_criteria: candidate source table is missing or incomplete
no branch-compatible proposal candidates are found
no selected repair candidate is identified
PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes or level3 claims are produced

commands.name: focused_tests
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_proposal_source_preflight.py

commands.name: run_preflight
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.proposal_source_preflight --base-checkpoint runs/m1362_bidirectional_active_set_interpolation_preflight/checkpoints/alpha_0_1.pt --candidate-checkpoints runs/m1362_bidirectional_active_set_interpolation_preflight/candidate_checkpoints.csv --alpha-summary runs/m1362_bidirectional_active_set_interpolation_preflight/alpha_summary.csv --materialization-run-dir runs/m1630_contour_aware_full_target_materialization --run-dir runs/m1650_proposal_source_preflight

decision_rule: M1650 passes if it identifies branch-compatible proposal sources and selected repair candidates without projection repair PPO or checkpoint artifacts.
